name: fms related receptor tyrosine kinase 4

function.text: FLT4 encodes vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 3. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in lymphangiogenesis and cell migration.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to congenital heart defects, multiple types, 7 (autosomal dominant); lymphatic malformation 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Angiosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
